name: Transit
author: Erin Carter
description: A rain-slick crossroads from a high corner window: head- and taillight trails stream through the junction on the axis with the green while the cross street holds a glowing standing queue, every lamp doubled by a smeared wet-road reflection. An unseen signal cycles, shifting a tiny corner lamp's hue and alternating which axis flows.

params.label: Traffic
params.effect: Density of vehicles in both the flowing streams and the standing queues; near the minimum a lone car works the junction, at max rush hour stacks deep queues and near-constant flow.

params.label: Signal period
params.effect: Duration in seconds of one full signal cycle serving both axes; short feels like a frantic downtown light, long like a lonely 3 a.m. intersection.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: How fast light trails travel on the moving axis, from slow cruising sweeps to quick rush-hour flashes.

params.label: Streak width
params.effect: Thickness in CSS pixels of each trail's bright core; bloom, queue lamps, and reflections scale with it.
